chapter: Marriage to Eve and the trio years
title: First trio job without drums or piano; finding Tal Farlow
summary: In Philadelphia with Mundell Lowe he felt naked without drums; he worked out how to comp behind the guitar and found Tal Farlow.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So I met the fella that -- he came in to (unintelligible) see me at Marco's Pub last evening -- Lee Gruber, went down to his place in Philadelphia, Joe said all right, I'll book you for two weeks. And, Mundell and I and a bass player went down. And it was -- an awful experience, no drums and no piano, I just felt naked, I didn't know what to do, behind Mundell when he was playing, it's just an odd feeling -- Felt like half of (unintelligible) you were there.

Well you were used to relying on things and -- and Slim Gaillard worked opposite us down there, but I went along like that for the first week or so, and I was just everynight, I'd go home and think about it and think about it. What do I have to do, what -- I have to solidify the thing.
The vibes are the center of the thing.
So I realized that I have to -- some way I had to coordinate this thing. Well the last three or four days, I found out how to play behind the guitar. Found out how to play comp behind.

Found out what I wanted to know there. Now the other part, I'd have to go around. So we came back to New York and Mandell couldn't go to the coast. So I went over to Billy Reeves' Little Club and I'd heard a trio over there and a guitar player who I liked very much. So when Bell said, 'Why don't you come down Monday, I have a friend and I think you two would get along very well,' so I said all right. So I went down to his place and he was going to cook chicken and I think we were back up --work opposite Duke, place above the Turf, remember that club? I don't remember the name of it. Bop City, I think.
So, in walks this guy and that would be Tal Farlow Talifano, which is the same guitar player from the Little Club.
